name: Advanced Structural Analysis
description: Matrix methods for 3-D skeletal structures: force and displacement methods including analysis using substructures and static condensation. Computational aspects of displacement method including in plane rigidity of floor slab, non-prismatic members, thermal effects, support settlements and shear deformation effects, behaviour of structures irregular in plan under horizontal loads, programming aspects of matrix methods. Non-linear analysis: second order and elastoplastic analysis, upper bound and lower bound theorems, plastic analysis of continuous beams and frames including inclined portal frames.
